concerns.text: FR-001 (download experimental $T_g$ data from Polymer Genome Project and NIST, filter for amorphous homopolymers and binary blends) is not covered by any task; the only download tasks (T005, T006) fetch SMILES and fragment data, not the required $T_g$ dataset nor the filtering step.

FR-003 (train Explainable Boosting Machine) is only present as conditional tasks T012‑T015 that depend on the missing $T_g$ dataset; without FR-001 being satisfied the EBM training cannot be executed, leaving the functional requirement uncovered.

FR-004 (generate partial dependence and shape‑function plots) is implemented only in conditional task T016, which again hinges on the unavailable $T_g$ data, resulting in no guaranteed production of the required interpretability artifacts.

FR-005 (validate feature importance against independent physical properties) is represented by conditional tasks T017‑T018, but these cannot run without a trained model, which itself requires FR-001. Hence the validation requirement is effectively missing.
SC-001 (EBM R² must exceed linear baseline by ≥0.05) cannot be measured because the baseline and EBM training steps are deferred; no task ensures this success criterion will be evaluated.
SC-002 (correlation between top‑3 feature importances and FFV/Chain Stiffness) is tied to FR-005 and therefore lacks a concrete, unconditional task; the current plan only mentions it conditionally.
SC-003 (sensitivity analysis of top features) is also conditional on the unavailable model and thus not guaranteed to be performed.
SC-005 (generation of ≥3 partial dependence plots) depends on FR-004, which is conditional; there is no unconditional task ensuring the minimum number of PDPs will be produced.

Constitution Principle VI mandates validation of EBM feature importance against WLF constants (C₁, C₂). No task addresses acquisition, calculation, or validation against these constants; the plan substitutes FFV/Chain Stiffness, creating a direct conflict with the constitution.
Task T020 generates data‑model contracts that already exist in the read‑only contracts directory, providing no functional benefit and acting as an orphan task not linked to any FR/SC.
